title: Group led by 49ers limited partner reportedly buys Seahawks for $9.6 billion

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Group led by 49ers limited partner reportedly buys Seahawks for $9.6 billion
sources.description: A group led by San Francisco 49ers limited partner Vinod Khosla reportedly has agreed to purchase the Seattle Seahawks for $9.612 billion.
